user.title: Monitor All Navidrome Users
user.description: Requires a native Navidrome administrator login. Listening activity for ALL users will be exposed in Home Assistant, including idle users. This integration performs read-only requests, but the stored account retains full administrator privileges. Enable EnableNowPlaying and DevActivityPanel on Navidrome. External-auth-only logins are not supported.

reauth_confirm.title: Update Administrator Login
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a valid native administrator login to continue all-user monitoring.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Navidrome Connection
reconfigure.description: Entity identities are retained. Leave the password empty to keep the stored password. Use only the same logical server; connecting a different server may reuse coincident native user IDs.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP(S) base URL without embedded credentials, a query or fragment.
error.invalid_auth: The native username or password was rejected.
error.not_admin: An administrator account is required for the complete user roster and library visibility.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check DNS, TLS certificates, network access and reverse-proxy timeouts.
error.not_supported: Requires stable Navidrome 0.64.2 or newer with EnableNowPlaying and DevActivityPanel enabled. Check BasePath, login redirects and SSE proxy buffering.
error.invalid_response: The server returned malformed or oversized data. Verify the URL points to Navidrome.

abort.already_configured: This server URL is already configured.
